remarks: OWNER FINANCING AVAILABLE! 8.13 Acres of Untouched Woodland with Creek & Hunting Stands! Escape to the peace and privacy of the outdoors with this beautiful 8.13-acre wooded parcel offering endless possibilities for recreation, hunting, or your future dream home. Towering hardwoods and evergreens create a secluded setting, while a scenic creek winds through the property, adding both character and natural beauty. Two hunting tree stands are already in place and will convey with the sale, making this a turnkey opportunity for outdoor enthusiasts. Whether you're looking to build a year-round residence, establish a weekend getaway, or simply invest in a private piece of land, this property offers incredible potential. Utilities are available at the road. Conveniently located just a short drive from Rushford Lake, Letchworth State Park, and the Village of Angelica. Looking for even more acreage? This parcel can be purchased individually or packaged together with the neighboring lots 14 & 15 for an exceptional opportunity to own over 18 acres of recreational and residential land. Taxes to be Determined.
